title: cost: autotune defaults + batching/caching profiles + quantization presets + unit-econ tooling
author: Jordan Li
release_notes: Added autotune defaults for batching/caching, introduced three quantization profiles (hq/balanced/low), and integrated unit-economics tooling into the Console and CLI. Default rollout is off for existing Dedicated customers; opt-in via feature flag. Improves token cost by ~18% on typical throughput workloads in internal canary.
description: Context: We're shipping the first phase of cost-optimization automation (ENG-7321). This PR introduces conservative defaults and tooling so teams get cost wins without manual tuning. Changes include: 1) new autotune service (controller + job) that suggests batching and prefix/KV caching defaults per model/route; 2) three quantization profiles shipped with runtime selection logic (hq/balanced/low) and a config API to pin profiles; 3) Unit economics surface added to Console and CLI (cost-per-token estimates per route, simulated savings from applying a profile); 4) migration and rollout plan + feature flags. Motivation: many customers see 10-30% unnecessary token costs due to suboptimal batch/kv defaults and unoptimized quantization. This work bundles safe defaults and actionable recommendations.

rollout_plan: Stage 1: internal canary on perf-lab + 5% traffic in Hosted for non-critical routes (2 weeks). Stage 2: opt-in for Dedicated customers via feature flag (next release). Stage 3: auto-suggest rollout for high-confidence suggestions after monitoring (30-day observation). Feature flags: AUTOTUNE_ENABLED, UECON_CONSOLE_PREVIEW. Backout: disable flags and revert selector mapping. Monitoring: cost delta metric, model latency P50/P95, error rate.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for selector determinism, integration tests for quant profile compatibility, and an e2e canary that runs simulated traffic through the cost-estimation pipeline. Canary observed ~18% median cost reduction for throughput-heavy routes. Stress-tested job_runner with 10k routes using synthetic telemetry.
upgrade_notes: No runtime ABI changes. Operators should add new feature flags to Helm values and set feature flags to false if they want no change. Dedicated customers that want automatic application of suggestions must opt-in. The quant profiles are additive; existing model pinning remains respected.
performance_summary: Internal perf canary: median token cost delta -17.9% (CI: -15.2% to -20.5%) on a sample of 42 workloads. Latency regressions: P95 +1.2% in rare cases where batching window increased; we guard with latency SLO checks and will reject suggestions that push P95 beyond configured threshold.
security_considerations: Autotune only uses aggregated telemetry; no customer prompt/content is logged. Feature flags gate autosuggestions. No new privileged APIs introduced. Security scan passed.
